bible_amendments.what: ## Rules rewritten to close four ambiguities found by the pre-write outline audit: what counts as a sighting, where the two Ridge witnesses sign, what an unanswered petition does, and who writes the Drowned Page line.

R5 clause 'in the keeper's own hand' -> 'by the keeper on watch, whether by the present keeper or by any keeper before her', because the per-keeper reading contradicted three other Bible files and would have made Creed's threat arithmetically false.
